mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has risen for three consecutive weeks from -44.4 to -41.3, indicating a durable return to public transport commuting. This increased transit footfall raises exposure to retail and recreation venues, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT weekly mean improved from -44.4 to -41.3 over t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the last 28 days mean despite TRANSIT continuing to rise or staying above -42.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility exceeds 25% above baseline, outdoor social activity becomes high enough to generate spillover trips to adjacent retail and recreation venues. This threshold crossing produces higher RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than the last 14 days mean when PARKS weekly mean exceeds 25.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous WORKPLACES reading below -32 and RESIDENTIAL reading above 9 indicate that workers are staying home. This shifts spending toward local high streets and lifts RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean < -32 and RESIDENTIAL weekly mean > 9
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -32.6 and RESIDENTIAL is 9.6 in t-0w
failure_condition: Under WORKPLACES < -32 and RESIDENTIAL > 9, RETAIL_REC in the next 7 days is not higher than the last 7 days mean.

mechanism_narrative: In the reopening regime, normalization of GROCERY_PHARM from -4.4 to -2.4 signals reduced precautionary stockpiling and more discretionary trips. This freeing of shopping capacity raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -4.4 to -2.4 over four weeks
failure_condition: In the reopening regime, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days declines even as GROCERY_PHARM stays above -3.

mechanism_narrative: A PARKS weekly mean above 20 indicates outdoor leisure is capturing discretionary time and spending. This substitution reduces indoor retail and recreation visits, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
failure_condition: When PARKS exceeds 20, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not lower than the last 7 days mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has weakened from -31.6 to -32.6, indicating fewer office commuters. Reduced commuter footfall lowers weekday retail and recreation visits, driving RETAIL_REC downward over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -31.6 to -32.6 over t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than the last 14 days mean while WORKPLACES remains below -31.

mechanism_narrative: Summer outdoor seasonality raises PARKS mobility, and this seasonal pattern historically coincides with increased retail and recreation activity. PARKS at 26.7 signals a seasonal uplift that lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from 9.3 to 26.7 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days mean while PARKS stays above 20 in summer.

candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean > -42 and GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean > -3
